name: BTP Best Practice Baseline — 2026.05
description: Opinionated baseline distilled from BTP best practices, CIS BTP Benchmark, and ten engagements' worth of lessons. Drop-in pack for every leave-behind deployment.

driftBaselines.note: Production subaccounts must have these labels for chargeback + access-review routing
Every prod subaccount must carry an audit-log instance (compliance) and alert-notification (ops)
Admin + dedicated auditor are non-negotiable for SOX/ISO walkthroughs
QA: label hygiene without strict cost-center attribution (often shared)
Dev: minimum hygiene, tier label only

rules.title: Production subaccounts must carry a costCenter label
rules.description: All subaccounts marked usedForProduction must have a costCenter label for chargeback and FinOps governance.

rules.title: Production subaccounts must carry a department label
rules.description: Mirror of costCenter but for org-chart attribution.

rules.title: Production destinations must not use BasicAuthentication
rules.description: BasicAuth is forbidden in production. Use OAuth2*, ClientCertificate, or Principal Propagation.

rules.title: No subaccount should be inactive for 90+ days
rules.description: Inactive subaccounts incur cost and create an unowned attack surface. Decommission or document a clear reason.

rules.title: Subaccount displayName must indicate tier
rules.description: displayName should contain prod / qa / dev / sandbox so cockpit users know the environment at a glance.

rules.title: Admin role collections must require MFA
rules.description: IAS authentication policy must enforce MFA for any role-collection containing 'Admin'.

rules.title: Production subaccounts must have usedForProduction = USED_FOR_PRODUCTION
rules.description: SAP Production support tier hinges on this flag. Misalignment leads to support disputes and incorrect SLA routing.

rules.title: Dev subaccounts must NOT have usedForProduction = USED_FOR_PRODUCTION
rules.description: Dev/sandbox subaccounts incorrectly flagged as production cost more, get production support routing for non-prod issues, and confuse audit reports.

rules.title: Production destinations must use HTTPS
rules.description: Plaintext HTTP destinations leak credentials and payload in transit. CIS BTP Benchmark §3.4.

rules.title: All destinations must use HTTPS, RFC, or LDAPS (no plaintext)
rules.description: Plaintext protocols are never appropriate outside isolated dev/sandbox. Even non-prod should prefer encrypted transport.

rules.title: Destinations to *.local / *.internal must use OnPremise proxy type
rules.description: These hostnames imply an on-prem system. Wrong proxyType silently fails to reach through Cloud Connector.

rules.title: Production destinations: only ClientCert, OAuth2SAMLBearer, PrincipalPropagation, or OAuth2JWTBearer
rules.description: Production must use strong, federated auth. Locks down to a small, audited set rather than enumerating every forbidden flow.

rules.title: Production must not contain destinations named *-tmp-*, *-test-*, *-poc-*
rules.description: These naming patterns indicate experimental destinations that escaped into production. Block them.

rules.title: Destination names must follow alphanumeric-with-hyphens convention
rules.description: Reject destinations with whitespace, slashes, or special chars in their names — pre-empts integration-test breakage.

rules.title: Every subaccount must be under a Directory
rules.description: Flat global accounts cannot carry access-review policies, chargeback hierarchy, or directory-level entitlement quotas.

rules.title: No subaccount should have more than 50 destinations
rules.description: Hygiene threshold: subaccounts past 50 destinations are usually orphaned dumping grounds. Audit and consolidate.

rules.title: Every subaccount must have an inferable tier
rules.description: Tier-aware policies (destination auth, MFA, etc.) cannot be enforced on subaccounts whose tier is 'unknown'. Tag with tier/landscape label.

rules.title: Production subaccounts must have a department
rules.description: Without department, FinOps and access-review notifications cannot route. Distinct from costCenter rule (different remediation path).

rules.title: No subaccount inactive for 180+ days (critical)
rules.description: Beyond 180 days, retention of an unused subaccount is rarely defensible. Decommission or document.

rules.title: Production destinations must not use NoAuthentication
rules.description: NoAuthentication = unauthenticated outbound calls. Acceptable only for public APIs in dev/sandbox.
